lead_strength.instructions: How strong a sales lead is this email?
criteria: Not a lead at all (spam, vendor, newsletter, job seeker, support, existing client)
Cold (vague interest, tiny budget, poor fit)
Warm (a real need that fits, but no budget or timeline yet)
Hot (a clear need that fits, plus at least two of: a stated budget, a stated timeline, a decision maker writing)

email_kind.instructions: What kind of email is this?

criteria.new_lead: A new prospect asking about our services
criteria.existing_client: A message from someone who is already a client
criteria.vendor_pitch: Someone trying to sell us something
criteria.newsletter_or_support: A newsletter, or a support request

needs_personal_reply.instructions: This email needs a personal reply from a team member today.
